string.text: This gravitational artifact attracts and absorbs radioactive particles, reducing the effects of radiation on the body. Very common in the Zone and is unofficially used outside the Zone for treating acute radiation sickness in exceptional circumstances.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: I.%c[default]

This artifact is made up of a granite-like stone deformed by an extreme gravitational force, resulting in a crystallized formation that has not been explained by science to date. Can provide moderate protection against psy-emissions and is radioactive.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: II.%c[default]

This glowing artifact can generate a local directed low-gravity field. Widely used by stalkers along with Gravi, a similar artifact, to increase maximum load. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: III.%c[default]

This bizarrely-shaped artifact appears in places with increased gravitational activity. Acting as a kind of sponge that absorbs radioactive elements, this artifact provides protection from outside radiation as well as from radioactive particles that have already made their way into the body.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: I.%c[default]

Gravi is formed from metallic substances exposed to prolonged gravitation. This makes it capable of sustaining an antigravitational field, and many stalkers use it to reduce the weight of their backpacks. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: II.%c[default]

The result of an interaction between a large number of gravitational fields, Goldfish produces its own powerful internally directed gravitational field, which renders items within its range almost weightless. This artifact is most effective for reducing carried weight, which explains why it is always in great demand. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: III.%c[default]

A reddish formation of compressed and fossilized plants, soil and animal debris. Can partially neutralize chemical poisons. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: I.%c[default]

This organic artifact consists of deformed, mutated animal tissue. When placed in a chemically contaminated area, Meat Chunk transforms the airborne chemicals into a mucous fluid. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: II.%c[default]
A stable Carousel-family artefact that restores tissue and shields radiation without the drawbacks of its lower forms.\n\n%c[255,235,175,95]Class IV: natural cooking base.%c[default]

A bright representative of the electrostatic family of artifacts, this artifact can smooth fluctuations in electric field density. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: I.%c[default]
A stable electrical structure that quickly restores stamina and disperses shocks without producing a radiation field.\n\n%c[255,235,175,95]Class IV: natural cooking base.%c[default]

This unique electrostatic artifact can resonate under the influence of psy-waves. Stalkers have learned to fine-tune the artifact so that it resonates in opposite phase to the main source of emissions, thus fully or significantly neutralizing their effects. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: III.%c[default]
Thorn

A class I Burning Fuzz artefact. It removes radionuclides, softens blast waves and slightly supports movement, but impairs clotting and increases psi vulnerability.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: I.%c[default]
Crystal Thorn

A class II Burning Fuzz artefact. It improves radiation cleansing, blast resistance and stamina support, while hindering wound recovery and psi resistance.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: II.%c[default]
Sea Urchin

A stable Burning Fuzz form that removes radiation, protects against explosions and supports stamina without the drawbacks of its lower forms.\n\n%c[255,235,175,95]Class IV: natural cooking base.%c[default]
Droplet
A class I Burner artefact. It slowly removes radionuclides and protects against heat and psi radiation at the cost of stamina.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: I.%c[default]

Even though Fireball is a thermal artifact, it can be handled without fear of being burned. This artifact is valued for its ability to maintain a temperature of 75 degrees Fahrenheit within a small radius, virtually regardless of its surroundings. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: II.%c[default]

This artifact is formed in anomalous zones with intense thermal activity. Actively consumes excessive heat, remaining cool to the touch throughout. Emits radiation.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: III.%c[default]
Slime
A class I Cold Jelly artefact. It slows bleeding and shields the mind, but sharply increases vulnerability to heat and chemical burns.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: I.%c[default]
Slug

A class II Cold Jelly artefact. It provides stronger bleeding recovery and psi protection, while retaining a substantial heat and chemical weakness.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: II.%c[default]
Mica

A class III Cold Jelly artefact. It quickly suppresses bleeding and forms a stable psi screen, with a moderate vulnerability to heat and chemicals.\n\n%c[255,180,180,180]Natural artefact class: III.%c[default]
